description: IMEI and IMEISV. A 15-digit IMEI must pass the Luhn check. A 14-digit IMEI has no check digit, and a 16-digit IMEISV has none either. Spaces and hyphens are ignored. This does not look the number up with a manufacturer. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/imei-validate
